mapper.sql: e.id, e.emp_name, e.emp_no, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.email, e.salary, e.job_title, e.entry_date, e.status, e.dept_id, e.create_time, e.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , d.dept_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.id
SELECT , d.dept_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
SELECT , d.dept_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId} AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.id

SELECT , d.dept_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 1 AND ( e.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.job_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( emp_name, emp_no, gender, age, phone, email, salary, job_title, entry_date, status, dept_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{empName}, #{empNo}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{salary}, #{jobTitle}, #{entryDate}, #{status}, #{deptId}, NOW(), NOW() )
